# Fixture sources

Saved real responses used by the adapter tests. Never hand-written; trim only by removing whole
jobs (or whole unrelated parts of a page, as noted). All fetched on 2026-11-21 with plain GET
requests (or the POST search call the job board itself uses) from public boards.

| File                        | Source                                                                                                                                                                    | Trimmed to                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| --------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `greenhouse.json`           | `GET https://boards-api.greenhouse.io/v1/boards/databricks/jobs?content=true`                                                                                             | 4 of 896 jobs (ids 6918763002, 8637736002, 8805655002, 8574655002: two India, one Japan, one South Korea). `meta.total` rewritten to 4.                                                                                 |
| `workday.json`              | `POST https://nvidia.wd5.myworkdayjobs.com/wday/cxs/nvidia/NVIDIAExternalCareerSite/jobs` body `{"appliedFacets":{"locationHierarchy1":["2fcb99c455831013ea52b82135ba3266"]},"limit":20,"offset":0,"searchText":""}` (India facet id read from the site's own `facets`) | First 4 of 20 postings; `total` (237) kept as served; `facets` removed.                                                                                                                                                 |
| `workday-job.json`          | `GET https://nvidia.wd5.myworkdayjobs.com/wday/cxs/nvidia/NVIDIAExternalCareerSite/job/India-Bengaluru/Senior-Verification-Engineer_JR2030308`                            | Whole response.                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `eightfold.json`            | `GET https://explore.jobs.netflix.net/api/apply/v2/jobs?domain=netflix.com&start=0&num=10&location=India`                                                                 | First 4 of 9 positions; only `count` (9) and `positions` kept (the rest is site branding and facets).                                                                                                                   |
| `eightfold-job.json`        | `GET https://explore.jobs.netflix.net/api/apply/v2/jobs/790319450010?domain=netflix.com`                                                                                  | Whole response.                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `oracle-hcm.json`           | `GET https://jpmc.fa.oraclecloud.com/hcmRestApi/resources/latest/recruitingCEJobRequisitions?onlyData=true&expand=requisitionList.secondaryLocations&finder=findReqs;siteNumber=CX_1001,limit=100,offset=0,sortBy=POSTING_DATES_DESC,locationId=300000000289360` | 4 of 100 requisitions (3 single-location, 1 with a secondary location). `TotalJobsCount` (278) kept; the `*Facet` arrays removed.                                                                                       |
| `successfactors.html`       | `GET https://careers.ey.com/search/?q=&locationsearch=India&startrow=0`                                                                                                   | Only the pagination label ("Results 1 – 25 of 3137") and the results table, with 4 of 25 rows.                                                                                                                          |
| `successfactors-job.html`   | `GET https://careers.ey.com/ey/job/Bengaluru-Guidewire-Digital-Senior-KA-560016/1448451533/`                                                                              | Only the `datePosted` meta tag and the `itemprop="description"` element; scripts, styles and page chrome removed.                                                                                                      |
| `google-careers.html`       | `GET https://www.google.com/about/careers/applications/jobs/results?location=India&q=Agent&sort_by=date&page=1`                                                           | A minimal page holding only the `ds:1` data block, with 4 of 20 jobs; total (41) and page size (20) kept. The data was re-serialised with `json.dumps` (same values as the page; `\u003d` style escapes become plain characters). |
| `generic.json`             | `GET https://www.amazon.jobs/en/search.json?base_query=conversational&country=IND&sort=recent&offset=0&result_limit=10`                                                    | 4 of 10 jobs; `hits` (30) and `error` kept; `facets`, `content` and `job_posting_search_request` removed.                                                                                                               |
| `lever.json` | `GET https://api.lever.co/v0/postings/meesho?mode=json&limit=100` | First 4 of 48 postings (all Bangalore, `country: "IN"`). |
| `ashby.json` | `GET https://api.ashbyhq.com/posting-api/job-board/sarvam` | First 4 of 42 jobs; `apiVersion` kept. |
| `smartrecruiters.json` | `GET https://api.smartrecruiters.com/v1/companies/ServiceNow/postings?limit=100&country=in` | First 4 of 80 postings; `totalFound` (80) kept as served. |
| `smartrecruiters-job.json` | `GET https://api.smartrecruiters.com/v1/companies/ServiceNow/postings/744000162953819` | Whole response. |
| `workable.json` | `GET https://apply.workable.com/api/v1/widget/accounts/bystadium?details=true` | 4 of 8 jobs (3 remote India, 1 hybrid New Delhi); `name` and `description` kept. |
| `workday-accenture.json` | `POST https://accenture.wd103.myworkdayjobs.com/wday/cxs/accenture/AccentureCareers/jobs` body `{"appliedFacets":{"locationCountry":["c4f78be1a8f14da0ab49ce1162348a5e"]},"limit":20,"offset":0,"searchText":"Conversational AI"}` | First 4 of 20 postings (no `locationsText`; the city is `bulletFields[1]`); `total` (2000) kept; `facets` removed. |
| `workday-zendesk.json` | `POST https://zendesk.wd1.myworkdayjobs.com/wday/cxs/zendesk/zendesk/jobs` body with the same India `locationCountry` facet, empty `searchText` | The 3 postings of the 17: one "2 Locations" and two "Pune, India". |
